description: Test vectors for Object Organization V1. Covers reclassify, scope resolution, bulk_mutate, rule_migration (revision/transition), merge, reference_rewrite, and sync interactions.

reclassifyCases.name: property_to_property_resource_to_note
reclassifyCases.description: Reclassify: change from Resource (property type=resource) to Note (property type=note). ID preserved, body preserved, unknown fields preserved.

reclassifyCases.name: reclassify_tag_to_folder_requires_move
reclassifyCases.description: Reclassify to folder-based type requires file move.

reclassifyCases.name: reclassify_with_competing_markers
reclassifyCases.description: Object matches both Resource and Note. Reclassify to Project must plan removal of competing markers.

reclassifyCases.name: reclassify_unidentified_markdown
reclassifyCases.description: Turn unidentified Markdown into an object. Only canonical ID and type identification marker are added.

reclassifyCases.name: reclassify_stale_hash_blocks
reclassifyCases.description: If hash changed since preview, Apply is blocked.

reclassifyCases.name: reclassify_destination_exists_blocks
reclassifyCases.description: If destination already exists (different content), Apply is blocked.

scopeCases.name: folder_scope_direct_only
scopeCases.description: Folder scope with includeSubfolders=false counts only direct children.

scopeCases.name: folder_scope_recursive
scopeCases.description: Folder scope with includeSubfolders=true includes subfolders.

scopeCases.name: mixed_scope_deduplicated
scopeCases.description: File already contained by selected folder is deduplicated.

scopeCases.name: base_files_ignored_for_object_mutation
scopeCases.description: .base files are excluded from object mutation scope.

bulkMutateCases.name: add_to_list
bulkMutateCases.description: Add value to list property without duplicating.

bulkMutateCases.name: remove_from_list
bulkMutateCases.description: Remove specific value from list property.

bulkMutateCases.name: leave_unchanged
bulkMutateCases.description: Leave unchanged does not touch the field.

bulkMutateCases.name: empty_string_is_not_delete
bulkMutateCases.description: Empty string input is not treated as delete.

bulkMutateCases.name: unknown_fields_preserved
bulkMutateCases.description: Unrecognized frontmatter fields survive bulk mutation.

revisionTransitionCases.name: active_old_resolves
revisionTransitionCases.description: In ACTIVE state with old signature, object with old marker resolves to correct type.

revisionTransitionCases.name: transition_old_marker_resolves
revisionTransitionCases.description: During TRANSITION, old marker still resolves to target type.

revisionTransitionCases.name: transition_new_marker_resolves
revisionTransitionCases.description: During TRANSITION, new marker (folder) also resolves to target type.

revisionTransitionCases.name: committed_old_marker_is_mismatch
revisionTransitionCases.description: After transition commits (ACTIVE new), old-only object becomes mismatch Issue.

mergeCases.name: same_type_merge
mergeCases.description: Merge two Resource objects. Survivor explicitly chosen.

mergeCases.name: mixed_type_merge_explicit_target
mergeCases.description: Merge Note + Resource into Resource. Target type and survivor are independent choices.

mergeCases.name: merge_blocked_by_unsupported_reference
mergeCases.description: If reference representation is unknown, merge is blocked.

mergeCases.name: merge_unknown_fields_conflict
mergeCases.description: Both losers have different values for custom_field — requires explicit resolution.

antiResurrectionCases.name: companion_merge_quartzo_stale_unchanged
antiResurrectionCases.description: Companion merges B into A. Quartzo still has B unchanged. After sync, B remains deleted.
steps: A and B synced to both clients

antiResurrectionCases.name: companion_merge_quartzo_edited_loser_offline
antiResurrectionCases.description: Companion merges B into A. Quartzo edited B offline. sync => explicit conflict, no silent resurrection.

syncInteractionCases.name: shared_settings_targeted_does_not_transport_object_bytes
syncInteractionCases.description: Targeted shared-settings sync reconciles only app/quartzo_shared_settings.md.

syncInteractionCases.name: content_sync_off_shared_settings_still_converge
syncInteractionCases.description: With vault content sync Manual, shared settings still reconcile via targeted sync.

syncInteractionCases.name: structural_migrate_awaiting_transport
syncInteractionCases.description: Structural migrate completes local mutations but content sync is off. Transition persists until transport confirmed.
